question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/test-state` be retained as the supported repository-local seam for first-party extension tests?
rationale: The refactor removes a private-core import by adding a new Plugin SDK subpath. Although it is documented and classified as local-only, the long-term owner boundary for this cross-extension test contract needs explicit maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Approve the local test seam
options.body: Keep the subpath repository-local, excluded from production/npm output, and use it for first-party extension test isolation.

options.title: Keep state setup Telegram-local
options.body: Revert the new SDK seam and retain or redesign Telegram-specific fixture setup instead of establishing a shared extension-test contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the local test seam
recommendation.body: Keep the subpath repository-local, excluded from production/npm output, and use it for first-party extension test isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commits and discussion identify this contributor as the available routing contact for the proposed harness and test-state seam.
